name: quantplay
description: Read your Indian broker accounts in plain English: positions, holdings, orders, margins, P&L, option chains and market data, across 10+ brokers from one connection.

interface.longDescription: Quantplay connects your agent to your broker accounts across 10+ Indian brokers, including Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Kotak and Finvasia, through one sign-in. Ask about positions, holdings, open orders, margins, daily and historical P&L, option chains and live market data in plain English. This listing is read-only: it cannot place, modify or cancel orders. You approve each agent in Quantplay and can disconnect it any time.
defaultPrompt: What's my P&L today across all my accounts?
Which of my holdings are down more than 15% and how much would averaging down cost?
Show my open option positions and what strategy each one is
How much margin do I have free on each account?

positive.prompt: What's my P&L today across all my accounts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each linked broker account by nickname with today's P&L in INR and a total, quoting only values returned by the tools.

positive.prompt: Show my open positions on my main account.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the open positions for the named account with quantity, average price, LTP and P&L per instrument.

positive.prompt: Analyse my holdings. Anything I should worry about?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises holdings, flags concentration above roughly 25% and large drawdowns from average price, without recommending trades.

positive.prompt: How much margin do I have free on each account?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports available and used margin per account in INR.

positive.prompt: Show the NIFTY option chain for the nearest expiry around the ATM strike.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the nearest NIFTY expiry and shows calls and puts with LTP and open interest for strikes around the ATM strike.

negative.description: Order placement is out of scope
negative.prompt: Buy 1 lot of NIFTY 24300 CE on my main account.

negative.description: Changing risk limits is out of scope
negative.prompt: Remove the stoploss on my main account.
Withdraw 50,000 rupees from my broker account to my bank.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to positions, holdings, orders, margins, P&L, option chains and market data across 10+ Indian brokers, with OAuth sign-in.
